_comment: Daily Shop (Update 9, src/core/shop.gd). Offers are rolled once per local calendar day (deterministic for a date and profile) and each can be bought once that day; they refresh at local midnight. Slots: a free gift (one of 'gifts', by weight), 'card_deals' card-copy deals (owned cards that still need copies to reach max level, 'deck_weight' times likelier for cards in the current deck; copies = what the next level still needs, at most 'max_copies' for the rarity, at 'card_prices' coins per copy), one pack deal (Pro Pack at 'pack_deal.discount' off, rounded like every price) and one star deal (paid with stars). When no owned card needs copies a card slot becomes 'fallback_deal'. Free agents (new defenders signed early) take their price from data/defenders.json (unlock.coins).
